description: This file defines the GLAccount class, representing a general ledger account entity in the Fineract accounting module. It includes properties, relationships, and methods for creating, updating, and managing GLAccount instances, including hierarchy generation and account type checks.

classes.name: GLAccount
classes.description: Entity class representing a general ledger account with hierarchical relationships, properties, and methods for managing account data within the Fineract system.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a new GLAccount instance from JSON input parameters, linking it to a parent account and assigning a tag.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates properties of the GLAccount based on JSON command input, tracking changes.

methods.name: isHeaderAccount
methods.description: Checks if the account is a header account based on its usage type.

methods.name: isDetailAccount
methods.description: Checks if the account is a detail account based on its usage type.

methods.name: generateHierarchy
methods.description: Generates the hierarchy string for the account based on its parent.
